title: Recursive pass — Hsiao Data Policy term calibration depth 1
summary: Calibrates the historical Data Policy council generation to 2020-2021 from dated public records while preserving Hsiao's individual dates as unresolved, then selects direct roster/artifact recovery as the next depth.

sources.publisher: Simons Institute for the Theory of Computing, UC Berkeley
sources.title: Sina Fazelpour

sources.publisher: German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina

provenance.method: historical term calibration without person-level date transfer

data.research_question: Can the Data Policy council term be bounded before recovering a direct Hsiao roster?
data.method: Triangulate independently dated council-member biographies with official WEF 2021 output activity.
classification_rules: Council-level term evidence is not person-level membership evidence.
Relative profile wording remains undated until paired with a dated artifact.
A missing search hit is a coverage gap, not an absence claim.

findings.finding: Multiple dated public records calibrate the relevant Global Future Council on Data Policy generation as 2020-2021.
Hsiao's WEF-confirmed Data Policy service still lacks a directly dated person-specific artifact.
